facts.fact: The working paper, from its own interviews, says Zanzibar's CRVS system, which registers births, deaths and marriages, is an outdated system that is difficult to update and relies primarily on paper-based records; it gives no date for the finding, so the paper's date of August 2025 is used.

The Zanzibar Civil Status Registration Agency, established under Act No. 3 of 2018 by merging the Births and Deaths Office with the Registration and Identity Cards Office, registers births, deaths, marriages and divorces with full executive authority in all 11 districts of Zanzibar, as at 2025.
